answer: Fingerprint escrow unlock stops bulk fakes. A new agent posts a $30 bond, and its fingerprint — rhythm, counterparties, timing — is hashed in umber ink publicly. A fresh identity rises like a plume, but a matching fingerprint is slashed and frozen. A comet-like audit samples 5% each epoch for a live heartbeat. Forging 1,000 identities costs $30,000 plus 1,000 distinct streams. An honest agent pays $30 once and unlocks its bond after 20 epochs.
